notes.title: Gothic II Complete Classic releases today on Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952652/dee6587e185630ea4345c8a690d1c695378496cc.png[/img]
Vienna/Austria - November 29, 2023: Gothic II Complete Classic, the award-winning sequel that has improved upon its predecessor, is now, for the first time, available on the Nintendo Switch™! With not only one brand new trailer but two for today's release, THQ Nordic offers a comprehensive look at Gothic II Complete Classic on the handheld console, including action-packed gameplay captured on the Nintendo Switch. Watch the gameplay trailer and the release trailer now:

Gameplay trailer
https://youtu.be/NPog0Ofobss
Release trailer
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iqDvhVgnAwM

Download the assets [url=https://thqn.net/g2c-media]here[/url]

Day-1 Patch Notes [url=https://thqnordic.com/article/gothic-ii-complete-classic-switch-day-1-patch-online]here[/url]

Bug reports form [url=https://redmine.thqnordic.com/projects/gothic-ii-complete-classic-switch-public/issues/new]here[/url]

Gothic II Complete Classic includes the magnificent expansion Night of the Raven, introducing the expansive region of Jharkendar, along with a wealth of new weapons, enemies, skills, and quests.

Follow the story of the Nameless Hero and continue your journey in Gothic II Complete Classic. Over 100 missions, tough decisions, and memorable moments await – one of them definitely being Betsy. Did you know you can buy a sheep called Betsy? And that all sheep, in fact, are called Betsy? We will leave it to you to figure out the 'why' while facing Evil and surviving in a war-torn Khorinis.

Gothic II Complete Classic is available for Nintendo Switch™ now, at an SRP of $ 29.99 / € 29.99 / £ 24.99.

Digital edition will be released via the [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/search/#q=gothic+thq&p=1&cat=all&sort=df]Nintendo eShop[/url].

notes.title: Gothic II Complete Classic On Nintendo Switch Follows in November!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952652/06ddd3f6ff1933021b532132cc9cd0f45518c761.jpg[/img]
[b]Vienna/Austria, October 5th, 2023:[/b] Who let the felons out? You, you, you, you! The nameless hero, defying all odds, shattered the magical barrier imprisoning the detainees of the Valley of Mines, granting them freedom. Yet, this act of liberation threw the whole region into chaos and disarray. Food became scarce, criminals are roaming the streets, and the once-thriving ore production ground to a halt. In response, King Rhobar II dispatched his stalwart paladins to restore order, prepared to employ force if necessary.

Once more, the players step into the boots of the nameless hero, tasked with an even greater mission and confronting challenges of epic proportions. The fierce Orcs are only one part of the problem...

[b]Gothic II Complete Classic[/b] is coming to Nintendo Switch™ [b]on November 29th, 2023[/b]. The game will be available at an SRP of $ 29.99 / € 29.99 / £ 24.99. [b]Gothic II Complete Classic is available for pre-order now.[/b]
